# truenas_alert_service (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS alert service by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the alert service to look up.

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (String, Sensitive) JSON document of service settings, as returned by the API.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the alert service is enabled.
- `id` (Number) Numeric alert service ID.
- `level` (String) Minimum alert level that triggers this service.
